title: Zesty Tunisian Shrimp Tagine
description: A bright, spice‑laden shrimp dish cooked in a fondue pot, featuring shrimp paste, harissa, and lemon zest. It is a quick, kosher‑friendly meal that brings the flavors of Tunisian cuisine to the table.
instructions: Heat the fondue pot over medium heat and add olive oil until shimmering.
Add diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for thirty seconds until fragrant.
Mix in tomato paste, cumin, coriander, and chili flakes, cooking until the paste darkens slightly.
Add shrimp, harissa paste, chopped dried figs, and chickpeas, stirring to coat them in the spice mixture.
Pour in lemon juice, sprinkle lemon zest, and season with salt and pepper.
Reduce heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for eight minutes until the shrimp turn pink and opaque.
Stir in fresh herbs if desired and serve hot over couscous or crusty bread.
